create_detected_object: create a DetectedObjectNode in agent memory from a detected object with position, features, and tags
update_detected_object: update an existing DetectedObjectNode position and feature blob in the agent memory database
get_all_detected_objects: retrieve all DetectedObjectNode entries from the agent memory with labels, colors, and bounds
create_human_pose: create a HumanPoseNode in agent memory from a human pose with keypoints and xyz position
create_dance: create a DanceNode in agent memory with a dance function, optional name, and tags
